title: Add version 3 of the indicative obligation check, with the latest content
why:
Version 2 was built to check our figures match NPWD, so it doesn't explain the obligation to a regulatory officer. Version 3 is a content design rewrite, for user research.

**What changed**

- The heading is now the year: "2027 indicative obligation", with the figure underneath
- A sentence on what the scheme has to do to meet the obligation
- "How this was calculated": the rule, then the weight placed on the market each year, with this year's reported and estimated figures as separate rows
- The sum itself as a summary list: the 3-year average, then 45% of it

**Also**

- Version 2 hasn't changed: it's still the one ready for dev
- The figures are dummy data
- Open content questions (battery categories, how the estimate is worked out, why an officer comes here) are to be confirmed
